INDOMITABLESPIRE2-CARRIER_AIRCRAFT.title: Carrier Aircraft
INDOMITABLESPIRE2-CARRIER_AIRCRAFT.descr: A special type of card that triggers effects applied to Carrier Aircraft. Has Durability and is immune to Thorns.
INDOMITABLESPIRE2-FIGHTER.title: Fighter
INDOMITABLESPIRE2-FIGHTER.description: A Carrier Aircraft classified as a Fighter, triggering effects applied to Fighters. Usually provides [gold]Block[/gold] or counterattack capabilities.
INDOMITABLESPIRE2-ATTACKER.title: Attacker
INDOMITABLESPIRE2-ATTACKER.description: A Carrier Aircraft classified as an Attacker, triggering effects applied to Attackers. Usually features flexible, targeted damage.
INDOMITABLESPIRE2-TORPEDO_BOMBER.title: Torpedo Bomber
INDOMITABLESPIRE2-TORPEDO_BOMBER.descrip: A Carrier Aircraft classified as a Torpedo Bomber, triggering effects applied to Torpedo Bombers. May apply [gold]Flooded[/gold] or [gold]Armor-Breaking[/gold].
INDOMITABLESPIRE2-DIVE_BOMBER.title: Dive Bomber
INDOMITABLESPIRE2-DIVE_BOMBER.descriptio: A Carrier Aircraft classified as a Dive Bomber, triggering effects applied to Dive Bombers. Usually bypasses some of the enemy's defense mechanisms.
INDOMITABLESPIRE2-LEVEL_BOMBER.title: Level Bomber
INDOMITABLESPIRE2-LEVEL_BOMBER.descripti: A Carrier Aircraft classified as a Level Bomber, triggering effects applied to Level Bombers. Usually features [gold]AoE Damage[/gold].
INDOMITABLESPIRE2-SKIP_BOMBER.title: Skip Bomber
INDOMITABLESPIRE2-SKIP_BOMBER.descriptio: A Carrier Aircraft classified as a Skip Bomber, triggering effects applied to Skip Bombers. May deal multi-hit combo damage.
INDOMITABLESPIRE2-DURABILITY.title: Durability
INDOMITABLESPIRE2-DURABILITY.description: Loses durability based on the target's attack damage when attacking an enemy intending to attack. [gold]Exhaust[/gold] when durability reaches zero.
